UPDATE reservations
        SET 
            title = COALESCE($1, title),
            -- An empty document clears the description, null keeps it
            description_rich = CASE
                WHEN $2::jsonb IS NULL THEN description_rich
                WHEN $2::jsonb = '{}'::jsonb THEN NULL
                ELSE $2::jsonb
            END,
            message_to_admins = CASE
                WHEN $13::text IS NULL THEN message_to_admins
                ELSE NULLIF(btrim($13), '')
            END,
            -- Null keeps the value, an empty string clears it
            admin_notes = CASE WHEN $3::text IS NULL THEN admin_notes WHEN btrim($3) = '' THEN NULL ELSE $3 END,
            contact_person = CASE WHEN $4::text IS NULL THEN contact_person WHEN btrim($4) = '' THEN NULL ELSE $4 END,
            contact_email = CASE WHEN $5::text IS NULL THEN contact_email WHEN btrim($5) = '' THEN NULL ELSE $5 END,
            contact_phone = CASE WHEN $6::text IS NULL THEN contact_phone WHEN btrim($6) = '' THEN NULL ELSE $6 END,
            -- Occurrences are replaced together with their rule, so a missing rule clears it
            rrule = CASE WHEN $12 THEN $7 ELSE COALESCE($7, rrule) END,
            status = COALESCE($8, status),
            cancelled_at = CASE WHEN $8 IS NOT NULL AND $8 <> 'cancelled'::reservation_status THEN NULL ELSE cancelled_at END,
            cancelled_by = CASE WHEN $8 IS NOT NULL AND $8 <> 'cancelled'::reservation_status THEN NULL ELSE cancelled_by END,
            cancel_reason = CASE WHEN $8 IS NOT NULL AND $8 <> 'cancelled'::reservation_status THEN NULL ELSE cancel_reason END,
            contract_id = COALESCE($9, contract_id),
            contract_printed_at = CASE 
                WHEN $10 = TRUE THEN NOW() 
                WHEN $10 = FALSE THEN NULL
                ELSE contract_printed_at 
            END,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $11 AND deleted_at IS NULL
